optOut.notes: Safety Holdings Inc. (d/b/a SambaSafety, VT Data Broker Registry #236039) explicitly declares IspersonalinformationOptOut=False in its Vermont filing and is absent from the CA, TX, and OR registries. As an FCRA/DPPA consumer reporting agency supplying motor vehicle records (MVRs) to insurers and employers, it offers no public opt-out route; its consumer portal (safetyholdingsinc.com / forms.sambasafety.com/232555830633961) covers FCRA file disclosures and accuracy disputes only and requires uploading a government driver's license photo.
